summary.content:
Today's selection covers 57 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 8 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: AI Model Rules Are Not Security Controls
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Berlin confirms data theft after Rhysida ransomware attack claims
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 31 articles published in the last 24 hours
